findings.claim: README still says v2 has 7 tools (no ctx_doctor, no ctx_upgrade). TECH-SPEC section 3.11 and Q3b say 9 tools, keeping ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade -- but TECH-SPEC's own GP1 test row also says 7 tools, so TECH-SPEC contradicts itself in addition to contradicting README.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/README.md:101 "7 tools: ctx_execute ... ctx_batch, ctx_index ... ctx_search, ctx_resume, ctx_stats, ctx_purge." (no ctx_doctor, no ctx_upgrade). docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md:215 "3.11 ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade (kept, rebuilt for v2)" and TECH-SPEC.md:409 "Q3b ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade stay as tools, rebuilt for v2 (3.11) [D]". But TECH-SPEC.md:289 GP1 test row says: "server starts with no npm step; initialize (instructions bytes) and tools/list (7 tools)" -- same file, same decision set, two different tool counts.
findings.fix: Fix README.md:101 to list 9 tools including ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade. Fix TECH-SPEC.md:289 GP1 row to say 9 tools, matching section 3.11 and Q3b. Re-run lint.mjs after.
findings.archaeology: git log --oneline --all -S'ctx_doctor' in v1 history (cm-main) shows ctx_doctor existed since the early ctx_ tool-prefix commit (4d2c771e) and has a dedicated resource-cleanup regression test (c71c2299, #247/#268). ADR-0017's v1-to-v2 upgrade path (install v2, run /ctx-upgrade, then npm uninstall) needs ctx_upgrade to exist as a tool. REGRESSION_RISK: high -- a 7-tool build with no ctx_upgrade breaks the only documented upgrade path and conflicts with the owner's rule that v1 users must not be left behind. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: any change to the tool count needs its own ADR decision record, not a silent miscount in a test-matrix row or a README line.
